review_limits: This allowlist is a snapshot proposal for a local own commit, not permission to push or publish.
No .env, ordinary/isolated databases, storage state, cookies, HAR, screenshots, browser runtime config or unbounded HTTP captures admitted.
Only four named isolated migration logs admitted; setup/tracebacks contain synthetic fixtures and source paths, not authentication/session/provider captures. Failed runs remain included.
JSON findings and CSV exports contain source paths, source hashes, selectors and bounded observations. Not every referenced raw artifact is packaged; package is deliberately not self-contained.
Links to omitted raw evidence remain valid only in retained local audit folder. Publish omission manifest with package; do not replace absent evidence by unsupported PASS.
Per-file full-text pattern scan does not certify all possible secrets/PII; unrecognized values, hashes of secrets or source-code context may evade patterns.
Root must compare selected SHA256/size at staging time, re-review any changed artifact, and inspect exact staged diff. Audit files are still being finalized.
doc-integration own-doc-delta.patch is an evidence patch with context; proposal never authorizes staging complete roadmap/capabilities files with foreign WIP.

Large selected CSV/JSON canonical metadata gets zip/gzip recommendation with original entry paths and uncompressed hashes. Compression is not sanitization; raw databases/captures never become safe by zipping.
Source fragments in semantic/call metadata are audit evidence, not foreign source files. Original product/config files and before snapshots are excluded.
Email scanner ignores only the inspected false positive escaped newline+n@transaction.atomic from a source decorator. No actual address is exempted by that rule.
self_boundary: Manifest and archive are excluded from their own member census to avoid recursive self-hashing; later local-save.json records commit outcome separately.
